result.title: Think-Capture: Active 3D Geometry Acquisition for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 VLM 在多视角稀疏下 3D 关系不一致的问题，提出按查询定位任务关键物体、再按需采集几何的框架：将零样本掩码提升到统一坐标系，用符号化 3D 状态抽象压缩为结构化文本，并用分层 GRPO 训练模型判断何时采用工具证据、何时退回视觉线索。
AI.relevance_reason: 「按需获取几何证据」与「训练判别证据何时有用或误导」直接对应视觉证据筛选和 LOOK/USE 决策问题，其符号化状态抽象也可供核查任务必要几何信息在内部状态中的保留方式。
